How to read this report

  • Timeline. One lane per client; each bar is one operation from its invoke to its completion, coloured by outcome (ok, fail: proven not to take effect, info: unknown outcome; CONTRACT §6.2). Hover for details. Shaded bands are fault windows (inject → healed); dashed lines are markers.
  • Observations (rows above the lanes and charts below) come from the runner's polling of pooler status RPCs every second (P24) and other diagnosis sources; they explain what the system did, never a verdict.
  • /metrics scrapes (P23): every gateway, pooler and orchestrator was scraped every second; the Metrics section draws the integer families ADR-0038 records (gauges as values, counters as per-second increases) and summarizes each per target.
  • Verdicts are cpcheck's, from the sealed history alone (CONTRACT §5.3); this page re-states them and links each anomaly to its operations.
  • Data. The per-fault metrics are embedded as canonical JSON in the element #cp-data; cpgate recomputes them from the raw history (K6.5).
